data.gender_notes: Azmat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azmat is a powerful Arabic name that means 'greatness', 'honor', or 'majesty'. It is a name that reflects nobility, respect, and strength, commonly used in both poetic and spiritual contexts. The name Azmat carries the meaning “Greatness, Honor, Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Azmat usually hope their child will grow to embody greatness, honor, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine glory and inner dignity — a soul with elevated character and noble purpose.
data.etymology: Azmat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Greatness, Honor, Glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azmat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In essence, the name Azmat reflects the pride and dignity that is intrinsic to Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Azmat reminds us of the greatness and majesty of God. It is a name that invites us to strive for excellence and nobility in our thoughts, words, and actions, as we seek to embody the divine qualities of greatness, honor, and respect. Ultimately, the name Azmat calls us to recognize and rejoice in the greatness and majesty of God, and to live our lives in a way that reflects His divine glory.
